blocks.text: Google's multimodal AI that connects to your Google ecosystem

Google Gemini brings multimodal AI into the Google ecosystem. It processes text, images, audio, and video in a single conversation, and integrates natively with Gmail, Google Docs, Drive, and the broader Workspace suite. For teams already invested in Google's ecosystem, this integration is the primary draw.

The multimodal capabilities are genuinely advanced. Upload a photo and ask questions about it, analyze a chart from a screenshot, or have Gemini process a video and summarize the key points. This versatility makes it useful for visual tasks that text-only assistants cannot handle.

Google Workspace integration means Gemini can help draft emails in Gmail, summarize documents in Drive, create presentations in Slides, and analyze data in Sheets - all without leaving the apps your team already uses daily.
Process text, images, audio, and video in conversations
Native in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive
1M+ token context window for processing large documents
Grounded responses with Google Search for current information
Custom AI assistants trained on specific topics and instructions
Connect to Google Maps, YouTube, Flights, and Hotels
For teams that live in Google Workspace, Gemini's native integration means AI assistance right where the work happens. No context switching between your email and a separate AI tool.
